newTitle.aicli: New AI CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini)

fields.name: Connection name
fields.command: Command (e.g. aider or ollama run llama3)

rdp.hint: Alternatively use DOMAIN\user or user@domain as the username.
rdp.clipboard: Share the clipboard with the remote desktop

aicli.presetHint: Starts {{command}} with the tool’s own login. Not installed? {{install}}
aicli.folderHint: After it exits, the tab stays a command prompt in this folder.

sftp.hint: Opens a file browser: this computer on the left, the server on the right. Sign-in works as with SSH.

login.hint: Typed after login, visible and in the shell history. Do not enter passwords; put a full-screen program only on the last line.

form.pickKeyFailed: The file picker could not be opened. Enter the key path directly.

run.title: Checks the entered data without saving

form.saveFailed: Not saved. Your input is kept.
form.deleteDescription: The connection is removed permanently, including from saved workspaces. Its active sessions are ended.

jump.label: Jump host
jump.hint: Connects to this SSH connection first and continues from there. Host and port above are seen from the jump host.

form.deleteJumpHint_one: It is the jump host of {{count}} connection, which will not connect until you choose another jump host there.
form.deleteJumpHint_other: It is the jump host of {{count}} connections, which will not connect until you choose another jump host there.

forwards.hintLocal: Listens on 127.0.0.1 of this computer only. The target is seen from the server.
forwards.hintRemote: Listens on localhost on the server. Other machines reach the port only with GatewayPorts in sshd_config. The target is seen from this computer.
forwards.hintDynamic: SOCKS5 proxy without authentication on 127.0.0.1. Enter it as SOCKS proxy in your browser or program.
forwards.hintTabs: A port forward runs in one tab of this connection at a time.

validation.hostMissing: Enter a host or IP address.
validation.portInteger: The port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535.
validation.portRange: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
validation.loginControlChars: Line {{line}} contains a control character such as a tab. Only visible characters and spaces are allowed.
validation.timeoutRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} or leave the field empty.
validation.keyPathMissing: Enter the path to the private key.
validation.domainTwice: Give the domain either here or in the username (DOMAIN\user or user@domain), not both.
validation.commandMissing: Enter the command, e.g. aider --model sonnet.
validation.commandSingleLine: The command must be a single line.
validation.namespaceInvalid: Enter a valid namespace, e.g. default.
validation.jumpSelf: A connection cannot be its own jump host.
validation.jumpGone: The jump host "{{id}}" no longer exists. Choose another one.
validation.jumpChained: "{{name}}" has a jump host of its own. This is not supported yet.
validation.jumpIsJumpHost: This connection is itself the jump host of other connections. Chains are not supported yet.
validation.forwardPortTwice: Port {{port}} is already used by another port forward.

access.hint: The first reachable connection sets up the tunnel.

context.label: Context
context.readFailed: The contexts could not be read.

cluster.readOnlyHint: No actions and no shell; logs stay available.

links.hint: For “Open in Argo CD” and “Open in Harbor”. Shellherd only opens links in your browser and requests nothing from these addresses itself. https addresses only.

validation.noAccess: Choose at least one SSH connection as access host.
validation.kubeconfigEmpty: Enter the path to the kubeconfig.
validation.kubeconfigPath: The path must start with / or ~/.
validation.accessGone: The access host “{{id}}” no longer exists.
validation.accessNotSsh: The access host “{{name}}” is not an SSH connection.
validation.linkUrl: Enter an https address without user name, query or fragment.
